description: Postgraduate specialization connecting environmental risk, disaster management and urban resilience.

title: Data Analysis
description: Postgraduate specialization focused on analytical reasoning, data preparation, exploratory analysis and the practical interpretation of structured datasets.

title: Data Science
description: Postgraduate specialization in data science focused on the end-to-end development of data-driven solutions, including statistical learning, machine learning workflows, predictive modeling, data engineering foundations and the communication of analytical results. This training supports the transition from raw data to reproducible models and actionable insights across environmental and climate applications.

description: International training in computational climate science, including climate data analysis, modeling workflows and deep learning applications.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineering
description: Postgraduate training in artificial intelligence engineering, complementing environmental and climate research.

title: Computer Vision
